summary: Enterprise customer Ben asks how to add a teammate to their workspace.
draft_reply: Hi Ben, great question! To add a teammate to your workspace, navigate to **Settings → Members** from your dashboard, then click **"Invite Member"** and enter their email address. They'll receive an invitation to join your workspace right away. If you run into any trouble or need help managing roles and permissions, don't hesitate to reach out — we're happy to help! — The Support Team
